characters.name: Hanen
characters.description: A lively and animated rooster with vibrant, multicolored feathers, symbolizing his early rise and claim to the cow. His demeanor is decisive and somewhat mischievous, with a sly twinkle in his eye. He has a proud and assertive stance, often depicted in mid-crow with open beak to assert his claim.

characters.name: Gjøgen
characters.description: A cuckoo bird characterized by soft brown and grey plumage, symbolizing its half claim to the cow. Gjøgen's expression is one of mild indignation, often with a tilted head and slightly ruffled feathers, indicative of being woken suddenly. The demeanor is chatty and persistent.

characters.name: Aarhanen
characters.description: A mature rooster with an elegant silver-grey plumage, embodying wisdom and fairness. Aarhanen's expression is calm and thoughtful, with an upright posture. He often appears in a setting of deliberation, mediating the argument with a composed demeanor.

characters.name: Første Gut
characters.description: A newborn infant with striking confidence and awareness, immediately engaging with his mother upon birth. He is wrapped in a simple cloth from his older brothers. His expression is serenely determined, with a hint of a smile, reflecting his readiness for adventure.

characters.name: Andre Gut
characters.description: Another newborn, mirroring his twin brother's resolve. He is similarly wrapped in makeshift clothing, with an innocent yet adventurous glint in his eye. His demeanor is one of eagerness and curiosity, ready to follow in his brother's footsteps.

characters.name: Lillekort
characters.description: A small and resourceful boy of early adolescence, clothed in tattered rags turned into splendid garments as the story unfolds. He has messy dark hair and a clever smile, embodying his determined and adventurous spirit. Lillekort is often shown in action, negotiating with witches or bravely facing trolls, showcasing his bravery and wit.

characters.name: Kjærringen (Old Witch)
characters.description: An old, hunched witch with a single eye, representing cunning and the magical powers she controls. She has a wrinkled face, a crooked nose, and stringy grey hair, clothed in ragged, dark garments. Her expression is a blend of irritation and begrudging respect for Lillekort's boldness.

characters.name: Prinsessen
characters.description: A regal and beautiful young woman, often clad in rich robes that transition from gold, silver, to brass tones due to Lillekort's actions. She has long, flowing hair and a graceful stature. Her expressions range from anxious fear during troll encounters to delighted relief and gratitude toward Lillekort, capturing her ongoing bravery and kindness.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: A tall, imposing knight with bright red armor that matches his name. He has a stern expression, with a proud and conceited demeanor. Ridder Rød often appears aloof and dismissive, especially in scenes where he falsely claims the credit for saving the princess.

characters.name: Kong Lavring
characters.description: Lillekort's twin brother, indistinguishable in appearance, with only minor differences recognized by their close kin. He shares the same scruffy, adventurous look with an air of nobility, wearing garments that match the status offered to him. His demeanor is friendly and cooperative, eventually sharing in the glory and achievements of the adventures.
